reading_issues: Height-axis chart with axis break: blue 'PIT 125' line and zig-zag mean the pit bottom is 125 cm above ground (HS 225, 100 cm dug). Heights calibrated on the 10 cm gridlines (12.63 px/cm). Mirrored layout (bars extend left from the right-hand height axis, ticks K/P/1f/4f/F left to right, evenly spaced); table columns Name / Grain Form / Grain Size on the right. Elevation printed as 5662 ft (= 1726 m; the filename says 1720 m). Aspect is blank in the header ('--') and not in the filename ('mid slope'), so aspect is null. Air temperature blank. Grain size is only given for the SH layer. The 'U-shaped box with filled dot' glyph read as RGxf (same reading as the 2025-12-23 Mt Field chart). The RG layer 170-224 has a tapered hardness bar (layer mean recorded). CT12 line is at the top of the thin pink SH layer (170 cm). No temperature profile on the chart.
